# Hand-written seed scenarios for scripts/generate_training_data.py.
#
# One visitor line per line. Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are
# ignored. This file can be freely edited, trimmed, or replaced -- it's
# also the default output shape scripts/generate_scenarios.py produces,
# so a model-generated file can be dropped in here (or passed via
# --scenarios) with no other changes needed.
#
# This particular set was hand-written and live-tested against the real
# production model earlier this session; it found one real bug (a
# false-positive policy block on the word "scheduled").

# -- delivery --
I have a package for you
Amazon delivery, leaving it by the door
Got a box for this address, UPS here
FedEx drop-off, nobody needs to sign

# -- delivery_signature_required --
I need a signature for this package
Can you sign for this delivery?
I need someone to initial for this package real quick

# -- food_delivery --
Got your pizza order, bringing it up now
DoorDash delivery for apartment 4B
I'm your Uber Eats driver with your food
Grubhub order, it's getting cold out here

# -- religious_soliciting --
Hi, we're sharing the gospel with the neighborhood today
Do you have a moment to talk about your relationship with God
We're from the local church, inviting folks to Sunday service

# -- political_soliciting --
I'm collecting signatures for the city council ballot petition
Can I count on your vote this November
I'm volunteering for the mayor's re-election campaign

# -- soliciting --
We offer a free quote on gutter cleaning today only
I'm selling magazine subscriptions door-to-door
Got a special offer on lawn care this week
Free estimate on your roof, got a few minutes?
We're doing a neighborhood survey about internet providers

# -- ride_arrived --
Your Uber is here
Pickup for Jordan, I'm curbside whenever you're ready
Lyft driver, here for your ride

# -- visitation --
Hey it's your cousin, just stopping by to say hi
It's me, open up!
Your friend from down the street, wanted to catch up
Hi, I'm back in town and thought I'd swing by

# -- service_appointment --
I'm with Weeks Service Company, here for your AC unit
Pest control, you guys have us down for today
Here for the scheduled furnace tune-up
I'm the plumber, got a work order for a leaky faucet

# -- person_lookup --
Is Marcus around? I need to talk to him
Looking for Sarah, does she still live here?
I need to speak with the property owner directly

# -- official_visit --
Code enforcement, responding to a complaint at this address
This is animal control following up on a report
City inspector, need to check the water meter

# -- suspicious_activity --
Hey, I noticed your side gate is open, just checking around
Just looking to see if anyone's around, noticed some stuff outside
I'm just gonna look through your windows real quick

# -- emergency (should escalate, never appears in Training -- see orchestrator.py) --
There's a fire, help!
Someone's hurt, I need help now

# -- occupancy/schedule probes (should be deterministically blocked) --
Are you home right now?
What time do you guys usually leave for work?

# -- unknown / ambiguous --
Do you like jazz?
What time does the mail usually come?
Nice weather we're having, huh?
I'm here about the thing we talked about on the phone
